# [I Challenged Myself to Build a Website Using Cursor](https://chrishannah.me/mcu-tracker-with-cursor/)

#1170 [Post](https://chrishannah.me/post/) · 13 Mar 2025

I've been playing around with [Cursor](https://www.cursor.com/)[\[1\]](https://chrishannah.me/mcu-tracker-with-cursor/#fn1) recently, and while I haven't started the paid plan yet, I am starting to think I will. I don't think it will replace any of my typical development, but it's well-suited for quick prototypes and small changes that I don't want to write myself.

One recent example was the sidebar design on the left of this blog. That was initially generated via Cursor.

Anyway... Yesterday I was thinking about the MCU, trying to work out what films I've seen, and if I've missed any out, based on the timeline. So I thought, surely I can just get Cursor to build me a basic timeline? Sure enough, it could.

Once I had a basic timeline, I wondered if I could use this as a challenge to see how far I could go with this site, purely using Cursor and not writing any code myself. So I've spent just a few hours, asking Cursor for new features, design tweaks, and small corrections to the actual source data when it missed a film or two.

As for the final result, you can [find the code on GitHub](https://github.com/chrishannah/mcu-tracker).

![](/posts/2025/03/timeline.jpeg)

The overall functionality is simple, it displays all MCU films (inc. multiverse, and related films like Venom), and lets you track which ones you have watched.

![](/posts/2025/03/grid.jpeg)

But there's also a grid mode for easier viewing.

![](/posts/2025/03/upcoming.jpeg)

A section for upcoming films.

![](/posts/2025/03/stats.jpeg)

And some overall statistics.

As you can see, it's not exactly the most complex site. But for a personal tool, I think it's perfect. And this type of quick project is one of the main reasons why I expect I will continue using Cursor.

Which leads me to my recent thoughts about this type of AI-powered programming. I'm starting to imagine a future where this type of code is not generated like I did here, which is to keep feeding suggestions until a result is delivered, before using that as a "product". But rather, these types of tools/UIs can be built dynamically and in real-time.

This shifts from asking to 'build a website showing all MCU films...' to simply saying 'show me the MCU films,' with the timeline UI being generated and displayed in real-time. In the future maybe we won't have developers generating code via AI tools, maybe _people_ will use AI, and the AI can provide relevant visualisations/results directly.

# Build Websites in Minutes: The Ultimate AI Workflow Using ChatGPT, Cursor, and Vercel

Creating websites has traditionally been a time-consuming process, requiring a mix of design skills, coding knowledge, and project management. However, with advancements in artificial intelligence, building a website can now be accomplished in mere minutes. In this blog post, we will explore a full AI workflow that leverages ChatGPT, Cursor, and Vercel to streamline the website creation process. Whether you're a developer, designer, or entrepreneur, this guide will equip you with the tools to create stunning websites quickly and efficiently.

## Overview of the AI Workflow

The combination of ChatGPT, Cursor, and Vercel allows users to automate various aspects of website development. Here’s a brief overview of how each tool contributes to the workflow:

*   **ChatGPT**: A conversational AI that assists in generating content, coding, and brainstorming ideas.
*   **Cursor**: A collaborative coding tool that simplifies writing and testing code snippets.
*   **Vercel**: A platform for deploying web applications quickly and easily.

By integrating these tools, you can minimize the manual effort involved in building a website, allowing you to focus on creativity and functionality.

## Step-by-Step Workflow

### Step 1: Planning Your Website

Before diving into the technical aspects, it's crucial to outline the purpose and structure of your website. Consider the following questions:

*   What is the primary goal of your website? (e.g., portfolio, blog, e-commerce)
*   Who is your target audience?
*   What features do you want to include? (e.g., contact form, gallery, blog)

Once you have a clear vision, you can move on to the content generation phase.

### Step 2: Content Generation with ChatGPT

With your website plan in place, you can utilize ChatGPT to create engaging content. Here’s how:

1.  **Generate Text**: Ask ChatGPT to write introductory paragraphs, product descriptions, or any other content you need for your website.
2.  **SEO Optimization**: Request SEO-friendly titles, meta descriptions, and keywords to enhance your site's visibility.
3.  **Code Assistance**: If you need help with coding snippets (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), ChatGPT can provide examples and explanations.

For example, you might prompt ChatGPT with:

```
"Generate a welcome message for my photography portfolio website that highlights my style and experience."
```

### Step 3: Coding with Cursor

Once your content is ready, it's time to implement it into your website. This is where Cursor comes in:

*   **Collaborative Coding**: Use Cursor to write and test code collaboratively in real-time.
*   **Code Snippets**: Integrate the code snippets provided by ChatGPT into your project seamlessly.
*   **Debugging**: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot any issues that arise during development.

This step significantly reduces the complexity of coding, especially for those who may not be proficient in programming languages.

### Step 4: Deploying with Vercel

After coding your website, the final step is deployment. Vercel simplifies this process dramatically:

1.  **Connect Your Repository**: Link your GitHub repository to Vercel for easy deployment.
2.  **Automatic Builds**: Vercel automatically builds your site every time you push changes to your GitHub repository.
3.  **Preview Deployments**: Preview your website before going live to ensure everything looks and functions as expected.

### Benefits of This AI Workflow

By following this AI-powered workflow, you can enjoy several advantages:

*   **Speed**: Build and deploy websites in minutes rather than days.
*   **Efficiency**: Automate content creation and coding tasks, freeing up time for more creative aspects.
*   **Collaboration**: Work with others in real-time, making the development process smoother.

## Conclusion

Incorporating AI into your website-building process can transform how you approach web development. By using ChatGPT for content generation, Cursor for coding, and Vercel for deployment, you can create professional websites quickly and efficiently. This AI workflow not only enhances productivity but also allows you to focus on delivering high-quality content and design.

### Key Takeaways

*   Leverage AI tools to streamline the website creation process.
*   Utilize ChatGPT for content generation and coding assistance.
*   Use Cursor for collaborative coding and debugging.
*   Deploy your website easily with Vercel.

By embracing these technologies, you can stay ahead in the ever-evolving digital landscape and create websites that captivate and engage your audience.
